title: Quick Price Update for every company on multax.kit.africa, in fours_customizations
commit_note: single code commit; the branch head adds only this report (a later commit). Deploy either: the app tree is identical (git diff --stat <code> HEAD shows FQP-1-REPORT.json only). The kit was rehearsed with FQP_SHA=fe153b5c29512a574b35c06fb1a801d7d29a704c
summary: Quick Price Update ported from Jamissang's jm-price-update into fours_customizations without anything Jamissang-specific (no settings, price control, floor, grants, fixed prices). Page quick-price-update: the user picks a company they may access (Company User Permissions; none = all); the company's selling lists (invoices of 180 days, its POS Profiles, the default selling list) are shown side by side, plus any enabled selling list added from a picker. Each list says which companies sell with it ('Standard Selling is used by 4S Industries Limited, Vox Lounge and Vox Lounge Nansana: a change applies to all of them'), each item says which other companies using that list also sell or stock it. Items = the company's (Item Defaults, invoice lines of 365 days, Bins) or all sales items; search, group, only-without-a-price; 100 per page; stock per company warehouse; last change. Cells are editable only where Item Price write (existing) / create (new) allows; every save goes through Item Price save()/insert() without ignore_permissions, one savepoint per change, <=100 per save, stale and changed-meanwhile checks (including a locking re-read against the REPEATABLE READ snapshot), >30% needs a confirmation, duplicates refused, UOM factors as ERPNext; each change writes a Quick Price Change row and the Item Price's Version. Page/workspace/icon roles follow Item Price read (minus Kit TV Viewer, plus System Manager) via a Custom Role synced on migrate; no permission is changed. Reached from the Item Price list button, desk search and the new Pricing workspace. Proof on a private lab bench in kasc-bom-lab (multax stand-in = labvox clone with production's Item Price rules): 36 tests OK, 43/43 hand mutants killed, headless Chromium as writer / 4S read-only / Kit TV Viewer, a two-connection race probe, and the deploy kit rehearsed forward, rollback and re-forward plus 4 negative gate probes.

permissions_today.fact: Today NO 4S user can update prices (facts of 2026-10-22: Item Price write/create = Sales Master Manager, Purchase Master Manager, Vox Accountant; 4S Accountant and Sales User read only). Nothing was changed.
permissions_today.what_the_page_does: 4S Accountants / Sales Users get the page (they read Item Prices) with every cell locked ('You may not change this price.'); a direct API call is refused with PermissionError (browser check fqp.reader). Vox Accountants can edit Standard Selling (and any list their rules allow) for the companies their User Permissions allow.
permissions_today.owner_decision: Grant Item Price write (+ create for prices that do not exist yet) to the chosen role(s) in Role Permissions Manager. Warning: Standard Selling is one list for Vox Lounge, 4S and Vox Lounge Nansana - a 4S writer would change the bar prices too; a company-specific list (e.g. a 4S selling list used on 4S invoices/POS Profile) avoids that. After changing who may READ prices run: bench --site multax.kit.africa execute fours_customizations.quick_price.setup.sync_access

risks: The page shows item names, stock quantities per warehouse and prices to every user with full Item Price read, also without Item / Bin read (items are read with plain queries as specified, like the Jamissang page). 4S Accountants and Vox Accountants do not have Bin read on the lab copy.
'Used by' / 'also sold by' name other companies (and that they sell/stock an item) to users restricted to one company - the requested shared-list warning; the owner should accept it.
Kit TV Viewer can read Quick Price Change rows (it has Item Price read) but has no page.
sync_access rewrites the page's Custom Role (and Pricing workspace/icon roles) on every migrate: a hand edit of the page roles does not survive; page roles are meant to follow Item Price read.

Vox fix trusts the baseline taken in 'backup' (right before 'code'): a Vox Accountant permission changed by someone between backup and migrate would be reverted (the kit lists every row it removes/restores).
A migrate of multax also runs every app's pending syncs/after_migrate: precheck stops when anything other than fours is pending; other roles' permission changes stop the kit (FQP_ACK_PERMS).
Rollback keeps tabQuick Price Change and its rows; prices changed through the page keep their new values (Versions hold the old ones).
Production data may hold duplicate generic prices (the lab copy has some, e.g. VX-0102 in Standard Selling): those cells are locked until cleaned up.

Concurrent saves of the same item serialize on row locks (Item + its Item Price rows) until the request ends; a deadlock with another kind of transaction aborts the whole save (reported to the user, nothing half-saved).
open_questions: Who gets Item Price write/create (and for which lists)? Today no 4S user can update prices; Standard Selling is shared by Vox Lounge, 4S and Vox Lounge Nansana.
Should stock columns require stock (Bin) read, or stay visible to every price reader as now?
Should a reason be required for price decreases (Jamissang did; here it is optional as specified)?
Should the Kit TV Viewer role read the Quick Price Change log (literal rule 'everyone with Item Price read' says yes)?
fours_customizations on any site other than multax? precheck will stop if so (FQP_ACK_OTHER_FOURS).
